opening.argument: The video walks viewers through Google AdWords campaign setup for inbound tech-support calls, including a specific instruction to adjust bidding under device settings. The speaker also tells viewers to avoid trademark and copyright infringement. These are operational advertising instructions, not evidence of a deceptive solicitation. The speaker does invite viewers to call or email for guidance and guarantees results on their advertisements, which makes this a consulting-style offer alongside the tutorial. That assurance warrants scrutiny, but the available evidence does not identify a payment demand, credential request, deceptive affiliation, or harmful outcome.
